audiences.title: Agency or consultancy

moments.summary: Attribution stops at the commit, so what authorised a change, what verified it and what governed it are unrecoverable.

signals.text: The whole record of a change is its commit message.
Nobody can say which version of the rules was in force when a change was made.
Work produced by a worker is attributed to whoever pressed the button.

examples.title: Six months later
examples.before: An auditor asks what authorised a change and what verified it; the artefacts are a commit and a merged pull request.
examples.after: The commit carries its task; the task carries the objective, the scope, the profile and the outcome; the ledger carries the verification that ran.

examples.title: The client asks what was done and why
examples.before: Reconstructing an engagement means reading diffs and remembering conversations.
examples.after: The events are structured and readable back per task, with the decisions and questions that governed them.

examples.title: Which rules were in force
examples.before: The rules changed twice during the project and nothing records which version any change was made under.
examples.after: The projections carry the policy hash they were generated from, and the policy is a tracked file with a history.

related_detail.title: Asking what the workers did last night, and getting a transcript
related_detail.label: Only transcripts
related_detail.hook: asked what the workers did last night and had only transcripts to grep
related_detail.summary: A conversation log records what was said, not what happened, so the operational question has to be answered by a person reading prose.

related_detail.title: Nobody can say why that worker was chosen
related_detail.label: Unrecorded routing
related_detail.hook: could not say why one provider was used for that work and another for this
related_detail.summary: Provider and model selection is made implicitly, per session, and recorded nowhere, so it cannot be reviewed or repeated.

related_detail.title: A change that no plan ever asked for
related_detail.label: Work with no contract
related_detail.hook: found a substantial change that no issue, ticket or plan ever asked for
related_detail.summary: Work arrives with no bounded contract behind it, so its scope, its acceptance criteria and its ownership are all decided after the fact.
